package_info.why_malicious: The Orion Platform updates were compromised during the build process, resulting in the distribution of binaries containing a backdoor (SUNBURST malware). This allowed attackers to gain unauthorized access to customer environments via trusted software updates.

execution_context.file_location: orion-2019.4hf5.exe, orion-2020.2hotfix.exe, orion-2020.2nohotfix.exe (SolarWinds Orion Platform binaries)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
Malicious DLL injected into SolarWinds.Orion.Core.BusinessLayer.dll (SUNBURST):
- On initialization, the DLL checks for specific system characteristics to avoid sandboxes.
- It establishes a command-and-control (C2) channel to avsvmcloud[.]com using DNS queries.
- It retrieves and executes attacker commands, including data exfiltration and lateral movement.
malicious_snippets.code_language: C# (compiled to DLL, loaded by Orion Platform EXE)
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the malicious DLL initiates a DNS-based C2 channel to avsvmcloud[.]com, receives attacker instructions, and enables remote code execution and data exfiltration.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code establishes external network connections to an attacker-controlled domain at service startup, which is not expected for legitimate monitoring software.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal Orion Platform DLLs should not initiate outbound DNS queries to unknown domains or execute remote commands.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate software may check for updates or license validation, but not via obfuscated DNS C2 to untrusted domains.

attack_chain.action: Malicious code is injected into the Orion Platform build process, resulting in tainted binaries.
attack_chain.leads_to: Distribution of compromised updates to customers

attack_chain.action: Customers install or update to the compromised Orion Platform versions.
attack_chain.leads_to: Execution of malicious DLL on customer systems

attack_chain.action: Malicious DLL initiates DNS-based C2 communication to avsvmcloud[.]com.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains remote access and control

attack_chain.action: Attacker issues commands for data exfiltration, lateral movement, and further compromise.

behavioral_signatures: DLL loaded at service startup initiates outbound DNS queries to suspicious domains
Unexpected network activity from Orion Platform processes
Remote command execution triggered by external C2
network_indicators: Subsequent C2 traffic to attacker infrastructure
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Orion Platform binaries matching known malicious hashes or versions. Inspect for unexpected DNS queries to avsvmcloud[.]com or related domains from Orion processes. Use EDR or network monitoring to detect DLLs initiating C2 channels or executing remote commands. Correlate artifact download and deployment logs to identify affected systems.
